# Ezekiel 17 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 17:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | The LORD spoke to me again: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 17:17 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-not with-an-army great and-a-company vast shall-Pharaoh act for-him in-the-war, in-pouring-out a-siege-ramp and-building siege-walls, to-cut-off many souls. |
| LOGOS | Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company will not help him in war, when mounds are cast up and siege walls built to cut off many lives. |
| PNEUMA | Pharaoh and his mighty army won't be able to help him when Babylon builds siege ramps and walls to destroy countless lives. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 17:18 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-despised the-oath in-breaking the-covenant; and-behold, he-gave his-hand, and-all these he-did — he-shall-not-escape.' |
| LOGOS | He despised the oath in breaking the covenant, and behold, he gave his hand and did all these things; he shall not escape. |
| PNEUMA | He broke his oath. He violated the treaty. He shook hands on the deal and then broke every promise. He will not escape. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 17:5 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-took from-the-seed-of the-land and-put-it in-a-field-of seed; he-took-it by waters many — a-willow he-set-it. |
| LOGOS | Then he took of the seed of the land and planted it in fertile soil. He placed it beside abundant waters. He set it like a willow twig, |
| PNEUMA | Then he took a seed from the land and planted it in fertile soil beside a plentiful water supply, setting it out like a willow tree. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 17:19 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'My-oath which he-despised and-My-covenant which he-broke — I-will-bring-it upon his-head.' |
| LOGOS | Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: As I live, surely it is My oath that he despised, and My covenant that he broke. I will return it upon his head. |
| PNEUMA | The Lord GOD says: As surely as I live, he broke My oath and violated My covenant. I will bring the consequences down on his own head. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
